documents.title: Conservation report
documents.text:
Conservation report: Liber Morvan (fictional, authored test material).
For Liber Morvan, decorated capitals in FY2025 was 126. Marginal annotations at Liber Morvan stood at 1078 in the twelve months to 31 Mar 2025. Liber Morvan had insured value of $1.7m in FY2024 (reported basis). For Liber Morvan, share of palimpsest leaves in FY2025 was 38%. The identification of the main scribe for Liber Morvan is understood as follows: an unidentified scribe trained in the same house. As to Liber Morvan, the place of production is: produced in a lay urban workshop.

documents.title: Palaeographic study
documents.text:
Palaeographic study: Liber Morvan (fictional, authored test material).
For Liber Morvan, illuminated initials in FY2025 was 163. Missing leaves at Liber Morvan stood at 26 in FY2025. Liber Ltd had ruled columns per page of 0.5 in FY2024. For Liber Morvan, share of palimpsest leaves in FY2025 was approximately 48%. The identification of the main scribe for Liber Morvan is understood as follows: the scribe of the sister manuscript at Elsing. Throughout the documents of this review, "decorated capitals" means the same measure as illuminated initials.
